name: Wazir Khan Mosque
assumptions: Courtyard floor set 1.6 m above the chowk: the dossier lists plinth height as unknown, the value is read from the portal steps in the aerial photo.
Top of minaret finials at 32.61 m above the chowk; stage heights are fitted to a crop of the aerial photo with a 5 m shaft width assumed.
Central dome drawn 8.4 m wide and side domes 7.0 m wide: the dossier diameters (7.01 and 5.87 m) are taken as inner values, outer sizes fitted to the courtyard photo.
Hall roof 9.4 m and pishtaq top 15.4 m above the courtyard, fitted to head-on photos; pishtaq width 14.6 m fitted from the courtyard photo at the 40 m facade scale.
Portal screen 14.7 m wide from the plan, top at 16.0 m fitted from head-on photos; dimensions are not published.
Twelve hujra bays on the north and south court walls and eight on the east, placed from the plan piers, match the published count of 32.
North facade bays (18) and rear (west) wall detail were not seen; north repeats the east shop arcade pattern, west is plain brick with the mihrab bulge shown on the plan.
South outer wall is plain brick because houses stand against it (Gulf News).
Roof kiosks: two modelled on the rear of the portal block from the aerial photo; a further pair, if any, was not visible.
Minaret shaft panel layout is read from the two best-seen shafts and repeated on all eight faces of all four.
Tile colours and patterns are approximations painted procedurally from named colours and photos; inscriptions are unreadable stand-in strokes, not real text.
Chowk paving, low wall and the small platform are simplified; the chowk is modelled at street level because the game has one ground height at the origin.
Tomb marker and kiosk footprint come from the plan, their heights are estimates; the Calligraphers Bazaar interior is not modelled, the shops are represented on the facades.
